job.job_description:
Duties Responsibilities

Develop, fine-tune, and deploy large language models (LLMs) and NLP solutions using APIs such as OpenAI, Claude AI, and similar platforms.
Implement and enhance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to improve information retrieval and response quality in AI-driven applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML/NLP models into production systems.
Contribute to building intelligent agentic AI systems with autonomous decision-making and task management capabilities.
Support data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation activities.
Assist in troubleshooting, debugging, and optimizing deployed ML models.
Research and stay up-to-date with advancements in LLMs, NLP, and AI frameworks.
Participate in code reviews and maintain code quality and documentation.

Our Requirements

Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Must be able to work between 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time Zone (ET) .
Strong communication in English and collaboration skills.
1+ years of experience working with machine learning models, especially in natural language processing (NLP) and large language models.
Hands-on experience with OpenAI API, Claude AI, or comparable LLM platforms.
Experience implementing and working with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques.
Understanding of agentic AI principles and architectures.
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with ML/NLP frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers).
Positive attitude, self-motivated, and eager to learn in a dynamic environment.

What You ll Receive

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge international AI projects impacting diverse industries.
Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing large-scale NLP systems.
Mentorship from experienced ML engineers and researchers.
Exposure to latest developments in LLMs, RAG, and autonomous AI systems.
Career growth and networking opportunities within AI and tech industries.
Flexible work environment with potential for remote work.
Job Category: Associate Machine Learning Engineer
Job Type: Full Time
Job Location: Remote
